newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Inco says H1 net down on nickel prices.
newsitem.headline: Inco says H1 net down on nickel prices.

text.p: PT International Nickel Indonesia (Inco) said on Wednesday that its sharply lower net profit in the first half of 1997 was due to lower production and lower international nickel prices.
It said in a statement that the company's net realised price for nickel-in-matte averaged $2.61 per pound in the first six months of the year against $2.84 per pound in the year-ago period.
Inco, majority owned by Canada's Inco Ltd, said net profit in the period dropped to $17.04 million from $39.50 million.
Inco also said production was down in the period because of a planned rebuild and upgrade of its Furnace No. 1, which commenced in late January and was completed in May.
It said production of nickel-in-matte fell to 36.4 million pounds in the first half of 1997 compared to 50.7 million pounds in the previous period.
The company however said the rebuild of the furnace was completed three weeks ahead of schedule and that production should be at maximum capacity for the rest of the year.
